subtitle: Know Exactly Who You Serve
sentences: Today, I would like to talk about market segmentation, a core topic in every MBA marketing class.
Market segmentation means dividing a large market into smaller groups of customers with similar needs.
Companies often segment customers by age, income, location, lifestyle, or buying behavior.
After that, they choose a target segment and design products and messages just for that group.
This approach is powerful because no company can satisfy every customer in the same way.
For example, Toyota created Lexus to serve luxury buyers, while the Toyota brand serves the mass market.
